question: I can't find any record or proof that I asked to cancel. Can you cancel it as of last month anyway?
reply: Without a record or proof of a prior request, we cannot backdate a cancellation to last month. Per our policy, cancellations take effect on the date the request is received. However, we can either cancel your subscription effective today or open a billing review for past charges if you wish to dispute them.
